ownership.insiderDesc: Single-class structure (one share, one vote) - no founder/family lock. CEO Marc Casper holds ~155 000 shares directly (~0,04% of the capital); a new large retention plan announced in May 2026 (cliff vesting at 5 years, delivery in 3 tranches between 2033 and 2035) to secure his leadership until at least May 2030. Governance de facto dominated by passive institutional investors (Vanguard, BlackRock, State Street foremost).

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: No formal quarterly guidance, but explicit phasing given on the call: H2 organic growth steps up to ~4% (vs 3% in H1) with Q3 and Q4 similar, and Q3 adjusted EPS expected to be $0.35-0.40 above Q2's $6.03 (i.e. roughly $6.38-6.43).
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 guidance raised at the 7/23/2026 call: revenue $47.4-48.1B (+6-8% reported; organic now expected at ~4%, the top of the maintained 3-4% range; FX tailwind trimmed to +$200M, -$100M vs prior guide) and adjusted EPS $24.93-25.33 (+9-11%), a $0.25 raise at the midpoint (= +$0.30 Q2 beat +$0.05 H2 revenue -$0.05 microbiology divestiture -$0.05 FX). Acquisitions (Clario + filtration/separation) now contribute $1.6B revenue and $0.32 EPS; adjusted operating margin expansion raised to 80bp; net interest ~$660M; adjusted tax rate 11.5%; FCF $6.9-7.4B (net capex $1.9-2.1B); $4B buybacks and ~$700M dividends; 370-373M average diluted shares.
pointsCles: Organic growth accelerated to 5% in Q2 (from 1% in Q1), broad-based across all four end markets: pharma/biotech (~60% of revenue) mid-single-digit, academic/government back to growth at low-single-digit, industrial/applied and diagnostics both mid-single-digit. Revenue $11.99B (+10% reported, incl. +5% from acquisitions) came in ~$300M above internal guidance; adjusted operating margin +90bp to 22.8%, adjusted EPS $6.03 (+13%), GAAP diluted EPS $4.68 (+9%).

Analytical Instruments was the standout: +7% organic with adjusted operating margin up 420bp to 23.0% as the 2025 tariff comp dissipated, driven by the ASMS Orbitrap launches (Tribrid Apex, Excedion), AI-enabled software and electron microscopy (semiconductor/advanced materials, very strong bookings). Bioproduction had another excellent quarter (no customer delays, unlike the largest peer; DynaDrive single-use bioreactors becoming the CDMO standard) and clinical research delivered strong revenue AND authorizations, with Clario excellent in its first full quarter.

Capital deployment running ahead of plan: $4B of buybacks already completed in H1 (vs $3B initially assumed for the full year), the Q2 $1B tranche funded by anticipated proceeds of the microbiology divestiture, now quantified (Q3 close; 2025 revenue $645M, ~1/4 retained through channel; -$200M revenue and -$0.05 EPS in 2026, ~-$0.15 dilution first full year). Leverage 3.6x gross / 3.3x net debt-to-adjusted-EBITDA, H1 FCF $2.5B, adjusted ROIC 10.9%.

Management raised only what is proven: the FY26 organic outlook moved to the top of the maintained 3-4% range on pharma/biotech strength alone, while the academic/government return to growth (US positive again, Europe very strong) and China's low-single-digit rebound (7.5% of revenue, academic still muted) were deliberately NOT annualized - optional upside if trends hold. Say-on-pay rejection at the 2026 AGM remains a governance watch item.

hypothese.summary: Organic growth accelerated to 5% in Q2 (vs 1% in Q1), GAAP and non-GAAP margins improving, buybacks more aggressive than expected (4 Mds$ as early as H1) and net debt already below the expected peak - the post-COVID recovery thesis is confirming faster than assumed at creation.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
The post-COVID-normalization turnaround is accelerating: organic growth went 1% (Q1) to 5% (Q2), driven by a very favorable Analytical Instruments base effect (segment margin nearly recovered: 23.0% vs 18.8% a year ago as the 2025 tariff comparison dissipated) and solid Bioproduction/Clinical Research momentum. FY26 guidance raised TWICE (adjusted EPS now 24.93-25.33, revenue 47.4-48.1bn), both times above street. Clario (closed) weighs on the financial line as anticipated.

== THESIS READ ==
- The organic reacceleration is broad, not just base effect - Bioproduction and Clinical Research carry underlying demand. Watch: Q3 organic vs the fading base tailwind.
- The financial line is the quiet headwind: interest income down sharply (207 vs 297M in Q2) post-Clario cash drawdown, net debt peaked ~39bn - deleveraging (to 8bn by 2030) restores it. Watch: the AN-INTERET ancrage each quarter.
- Buybacks run FASTER than the initial -2%/yr assumption - EPS support the model already partially captures (shares to 336M by 2030). Watch: pace vs deleveraging priority.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Base = GAAP keeping acquisition amortization and restructuring (E5e) - structural gap vs adjusted guidance (Omnium 19.97 vs ~25.13 guided for 2026), documented. GAAP tax structurally very low: 9% normative, FY25 actual 6.5% (validated; the W4 check floor was widened to 6% for this profile). Clario acquisition consolidated - net debt 36bn (2025) peaking ~39bn (2026).

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 48.7bn, EBIT 8.6bn (GAAP base), EPS 19.97; 2027-2030: revenue +5.5%/yr, margin drift, deleveraging 39 -> 8bn with finNet improving -611 -> -297; shares -2%/yr+. Watch: Clario integration economics; academic/government funding environment; China demand.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (Oct); Clario synergy quantification; 2027 guidance (Jan); bioproduction order trends.

ancrages.moteur: Organic growth accelerated to 5% in Q2 26 (against 1% in Q1), FY2026 guidance raised again on the 23/07 call (exact amount not confirmed, see watch-list) - trajectory above the creation estimate (detailed confidence: high (2026), medium (2027-2028), low (2029-2030)).

GAAP operating margin Q2 26 at 17,4% (H1 26: 17,2%), in line with or even slightly above the gradual recovery trajectory anticipated at creation (17,8% targeted for FY2026); Analytical Instruments margin almost restored (23,0% against 18,8% a year earlier) with the fading of the 2025 customs tariff effect (detailed confidence: medium (a precise quantification of the remaining Clario/Solventum integration costs is still not available)).
Normative tax rate ~9% validated by the GAAP effective rate observed in H1 26 (6,5%, Q2 alone 8,7%) - a structural item confirmed, not adjusted (detailed confidence: high (revalidated this refresh)).

Interest expense almost stable in Q2 26 (401 M$ against 404 M$ a year earlier) but interest income sharply down (207 M$ against 297 M$) on the back of the lower cash balance after the Clario payment (8,87 Mds$ in March 2026) - confirms the anticipated pressure on net financial income, gradually eased through deleveraging.

Buyback pace above the initial plan: 4,0 Mds$ disbursed as early as H1 2026 (of which 1,0 Md$ in Q2 alone) against 3 Mds$ assumed for the full year at the Q1 call - share count reduction faster than the ~2%/yr assumption taken at creation.

Mid-year net debt (~38,5 Mds$ at 30/06/2026) already below the 42 Mds$ peak expected for year-end in the creation model, despite the full Clario payment - deleveraging trajectory better than expected (detailed confidence: medium (revised up from low, the trajectory now being confirmed by an actual data point)).

Divestiture of the microbiology business announced in Q2 2026, amount and closing timetable not specified at this stage - pure positive optionality on capital allocation and deleveraging, excluded from adjXXX as long as the terms are not known (detailed confidence: high on the occurrence, nil on the amount).
